message:
Let me check the work directory structure and look for any build artifacts or submit script:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul -type f 2>/dev/null | head -40 && echo "===" && ls -la /workspace/ && echo "===" && find /workspace -name "submit.sh" 2>/dev/null</｜｜DSML｜｜>
